results.question: How many customers do we have?
results.model_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM "Customer" LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Customer

results.question: List all music genres.
results.model_sql: SELECT "Name" AS genre FROM "Genre" ORDER BY "Name" LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name

results.question: How many invoices are from the USA?
results.model_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_invoices FROM "Invoice" WHERE "BillingCountry" = 'USA' LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'USA'

results.question: What are the 5 longest tracks by duration?
results.model_sql: SELECT "Name" AS track_name, "Milliseconds" AS duration_ms FROM "Track" ORDER BY "Milliseconds" DESC LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: List the first 10 artists in alphabetical order.
results.model_sql: SELECT "Name" AS artist FROM "Artist" ORDER BY "Name" ASC LIMIT 10
results.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name LIMIT 10

results.question: Which country has the most customers?
results.model_sql: SELECT c."Country", COUNT(c."CustomerId") AS n_customers FROM "Customer" AS c GROUP BY c."Country" ORDER BY n_customers DESC LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS n_customers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY n_customers DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the total revenue for each year?
results.model_sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "InvoiceDate") AS INT) AS year, ROUND(SUM("Total"), 2) AS revenue FROM "Invoice" GROUP BY year ORDER BY year LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) AS year, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

results.question: Who is the top-selling artist by total revenue?
results.model_sql: SELECT ar."Name" AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il."UnitPrice" * il."Quantity"), 2) AS total_revenue FROM "InvoiceLine" AS il JOIN "Track" AS t USING ("TrackId") JOIN "Album" AS al USING ("AlbumId") JOIN "Artist" AS ar USING ("ArtistId") GROUP BY ar."Name" ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN Album al USING(AlbumId) JOIN Artist ar USING(ArtistId) GROUP BY ar.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the average invoice total across all invoices?
results.model_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("Total"), 2) AS avg_invoice_total FROM "Invoice" LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_total FROM Invoice

results.question: List the top 10 best-selling tracks by revenue.
results.model_sql: SELECT t."Name" AS track, ROUND(SUM(il."UnitPrice" * il."Quantity"), 2) AS revenue FROM "InvoiceLine" AS il JOIN "Track" AS t USING ("TrackId") GROUP BY t."Name" ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
results.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name AS track, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) GROUP BY t.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: How many tracks exist in each genre?
results.model_sql: SELECT g."Name" AS genre, COUNT(t."TrackId") AS n_tracks FROM "Genre" AS g LEFT JOIN "Track" AS t USING ("GenreId") GROUP BY g."Name" ORDER BY g."Name" LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(*) AS n_tracks FROM Track t JOIN Genre g USING(GenreId) GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY n_tracks DESC

results.question: Which employee supports the most customers?
results.model_sql: SELECT e."FirstName" || ' ' || e."LastName" AS employee, COUNT(c."CustomerId") AS n_customers FROM "Employee" AS e JOIN "Customer" AS c ON c."SupportRepId" = e."EmployeeId" GROUP BY e."FirstName", e."LastName" ORDER BY n_customers DESC LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, COUNT(c.CustomerId) AS n_customers FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY employee ORDER BY n_customers DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: What is the average invoice total per country, sorted highest first?
results.model_sql: SELECT i."BillingCountry" AS country, ROUND(AVG(i."Total"), 2) AS avg_invoice_total FROM "Invoice" AS i GROUP BY i."BillingCountry" ORDER BY avg_invoice_total DESC LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry AS country, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS avg_total FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY avg_total DESC

results.question: Who is the single highest-spending customer and what is their total spend?
results.model_sql: SELECT c."FirstName" || ' ' || c."LastName" AS customer, ROUND(SUM(i."Total"), 2) AS total_spend FROM "Invoice" AS i JOIN "Customer" AS c USING ("CustomerId") GROUP BY c."FirstName", c."LastName" ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS customer, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS spend FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c USING(CustomerId) GROUP BY customer ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: List artists whose total album revenue is greater than 20 dollars.
results.model_sql: SELECT ar."Name" AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il."UnitPrice" * il."Quantity"), 2) AS revenue FROM "InvoiceLine" AS il JOIN "Track" AS t USING ("TrackId") JOIN "Album" AS al USING ("AlbumId") JOIN "Artist" AS ar USING ("ArtistId") GROUP BY ar."Name" HAVING SUM(il."UnitPrice" * il."Quantity") > 20 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name AS artist, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) JOIN Album al USING(AlbumId) JOIN Artist ar USING(ArtistId) GROUP BY ar.Name HAVING SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) > 20 ORDER BY revenue DESC

results.question: Show monthly revenue for the year 2010.
results.model_sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', "InvoiceDate") AS DATE) AS month, ROUND(SUM("Total"), 2) AS revenue FROM "Invoice" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "InvoiceDate") = 2010 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM InvoiceDate) AS month, ROUND(SUM(Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Invoice WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM InvoiceDate) = 2010 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

results.question: What is the most popular media type by number of tracks?
results.model_sql: SELECT mt."Name" AS media_type, COUNT(t."TrackId") AS n_tracks FROM "Track" AS t JOIN "MediaType" AS mt USING ("MediaTypeId") GROUP BY mt."Name" ORDER BY n_tracks DESC LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: SELECT m.Name AS media_type, COUNT(*) AS n_tracks FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m USING(MediaTypeId) GROUP BY m.Name ORDER BY n_tracks DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: List the top 5 playlists by total track duration.
results.model_sql: SELECT p."Name" AS playlist, SUM(t."Milliseconds") AS total_duration FROM "Playlist" AS p JOIN "PlaylistTrack" AS pt USING ("PlaylistId") JOIN "Track" AS t USING ("TrackId") GROUP BY p."Name" ORDER BY total_duration DESC LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT p.Name AS playlist, SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS total_ms FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt USING(PlaylistId) JOIN Track t USING(TrackId) GROUP BY p.Name ORDER BY total_ms DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: Rank employees by the total revenue coming from their supported customers.
results.model_sql: SELECT e."FirstName" || ' ' || e."LastName" AS employee, ROUND(SUM(i."Total"), 2) AS total_revenue FROM "Employee" AS e JOIN "Customer" AS c ON c."SupportRepId" = e."EmployeeId" JOIN "Invoice" AS i ON i."CustomerId" = c."CustomerId" GROUP BY e."FirstName", e."LastName" ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 500
results.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS employee, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS revenue FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i USING(CustomerId) GROUP BY employee ORDER BY revenue DESC
